description: Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to vary Conditions 2 (Temporary Use Period) and 4 (Access Hours) for Application Reference Number: 21/02920/FUL ("Temporary Change of Use from Office - Class E(g)(i) to Provision of Education facility - Class F1(a)") dated 26/08/2022. Variation of wording of Condition 2 to extend the permitted period for the educational use and Condition 4 to allow weekend site access.

decision_conditions: The temporary use hereby permitted shall not continue beyond 1st September 2030. After this date the approved temporary use shall cease and the premises shall revert back to its lawful office use within Class E(g)(i) of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2020. Reason: To ensure that the long term employment/office use of the site is protected in line with Policy DM17 of the Kingston Core Strategy (2012).

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended)(or any Order revoking or re-enacting this Order), the proposed temporary change of use hereby permitted shall only include educational and teaching facilities (Use Class F1(a)) in conjunction with Kingston University, and for no other purpose within Use Class F1, or any other planning Use Classes. Reason: This application for the proposed temporary change of use has been assessed and found to be acceptable on its own merits. Alternative uses could have different implications for flood risk, highways and transport, neighbouring amenity and employment use which would require formal assessment.

No access to the River House building shall be provided to students outside of the hours listed below: Monday - Friday: 08:00 - 20:00, Saturdays: 09:00 - 18:00, in addition to 09:00 - 20:00 for a maximum of 6 times per year for university open days and degree shows when access may be provided to students, staff and the public and Sundays: 09:00-18:00. The use of the building on weekends referred to above shall be undertaken in strict accordance with the supporting Management Plan - River House Weekend Access (dated 21/07/2026). Reason: To safeguard the amenities of occupiers of neighbouring properties in accordance with Policy DM10 of the Kingston Core Strategy (2012).

The car parking spaces located to the front of the property shall only be occupied by staff/visitors to the site and not by students of the University. Reason: To ensure that suitable off-street staff parking remains and to encourage more sustainable modes to travel in accordance with Policies DM8 and DM10 of the Kingston Core Strategy (2012).

Within 3 months of the date of this decision notice, a copy of the River House Evacuation Plan shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval. The submitted plan must include  measures set out within the Bidwells Cover Letter dated 11.08.2022, including photographs of the flood warning notices posted at the internal entrance to the site. The temporary use shall be carried out in accordance with the approved River House Evacuation Plan.Reason: To ensure that the proposed temporary use is safe from a flood risk perspective for its lifetime in accordance with Policy DM10 of the Kingston Core Strategy (2012) and the NPPF (2026).
